svg.title: Now, next, and the engine we are building
svg.desc: Now: extend the 9,266 aligned recorded steps after correcting door timing and expand the 26 of 44 adopted gameplay checks. Collision bank sm_94 is retired; normal input, demos and the complete Varia/Gravity suit sequence use owned player state. Banks sm_94 and sm_91 are deleted; sm_90 has 1,306 lines left. Initialization is owned and the closing-gate spawn parameter is fixed. X-ray and direct damage are owned. Cannon control and palettes are owned. Wave Beam pickup passes. Next are Crocomire and scripted movement. Mother Brain player reactions are owned, but natural encounter coverage is pending. These tracks lead to safe owned state and deletion of duplicate RAM code, then independent video and audio from boot to credits. Target: a Map Rando engine below 100,000 production lines, with custom sprites, reordered rooms and doors, and opt-in quality-of-life mechanics. Future boxes are goals, not completed work.

g.aria-label: Done: cannon control owned; sm_91 deleted. Next: scripted movement in sm_90
Achieves: safe owned state with duplicate RAM code deleted
